scientific_integrity: Analytic Fourier spectral and cubic normal-form proof, supported by symbolic and finite numerical checks. Claims of priority remain contingent on independent literature verification.
scientific_limitations: The Hopf and branch conclusions are local to the nonzero-twist sector and small coupling interval, with no global attractor claim. A weight-schemes study from September 2026 was bibliographically identified but not inspected in full.
title: Universal subcritical Hopf onset in a directed two-hop Kuramoto ring
